subject: MAP: Finalize load test slot and dedicated capacity sizing
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ella Ramos <ella.ramos@fintechco.com>; Sergio Lopez <sergio.lopez@fintechco.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + proposed MAP milestone: load test slot and sizing

Hi Ella / Sergio —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and the MAP milestone I promised:

Summary of ask
- FintechCo wants a production-representative traffic replay to validate peak QPS and failover behavior before go-live.
- Goal: validate end-to-end latency < 300ms P95, service stays within error budget at peak expected QPS, and confirm cache/warmup behavior for cold starts.

Proposed MAP milestone (draft)
- Milestone name: Load test + traffic replay (MAP v1)
- Target close: 2027-05-07 (requested by your infra team)
- Responsibilities:
  - FintechCo: provide anonymized traffic sample window (24h preferred), SRE on-call for test window, whitelist our test IPs.
  - Redwood: provide dedicated capacity sizing proposal, run replay, provide runbook and measurements, escalate plan if SLA exception needed.
- Dependencies: DocuSign for MAP signoff, access to staging VPC peering, and a mutually agreed test blackout window.

Immediate ask for next steps
1) Can you confirm the traffic window you can share (dates + sample retention policy)?
2) Do you have any hard blackout windows 2027-05-03 — 2027-05-10?
3) I attached a one-sheet sizing questionnaire and initial traffic-sample template; please return by EOD Tue.

Attachments: FintechCo_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), traffic_sample_summary.csv (example)

If this looks right I’ll convert MAP v1 to a formal milestone in HubSpot and loop-in Marissa for runbook approvals.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Ella Ramos <ella.ramos@fintechco.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Lopez <sergio.lopez@fintechco.com>, FintechCo Infra Team <infra-team@fintechco.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed MAP milestone: load test slot and sizing

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few items from our side:

1) Traffic window: we can export an anonymized 24-hour window from 2027-04-28 00:00 UTC — 2027-04-28 23:59 UTC. We will scrub PII but will keep request/response sizes, paths, and header aggregates.
2) Blackout windows: none planned between 2027-05-03 and 2027-05-10 today. We do have an internal deploy scheduled 2027-05-06 (00:00–04:00 UTC) that we prefer to avoid.
3) DocuSign: procurement team needs a redline review — can you share the MAP in DocuSign by 2027-04-27 so we can route?

One constraint: our peak is spiky (burst from 8k to ~18k qps for ~5s). We need the replay to support burst fidelity; please call out if dedicated capacity needs to handle instantaneous bursts or if we should model as sustained input.

Cc-ing Sergio and infra so they can validate access lists.

—Ella
Senior SRE, FintechCo

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ella Ramos <ella.ramos@fintechco.com>, FintechCo Infra Team <infra-team@fintechco.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed MAP milestone: load test slot and sizing

Ella —

Thanks for the traffic window — that’s perfect. Quick technical notes and a sizing proposal based on your burst profile:

Sizing assumptions (prelim)
- Replay fidelity: will preserve per-minute and per-second timestamps so short bursts are retained.
- Warmup: we expect a 15–20 minute warmup at 30% peak to populate KV caches.
- Peak target: support instantaneous bursts up to 20k qps for up to 30s. Sustained peak window modeled at 8k qps over 5 minutes for cost/thermal planning.
- Suggested dedicated capacity: 4x g5-like GPUs in dedicated pool with continuous batching and prefix caching enabled. This yields capacity headroom for spikes and avoids cold-start penalties.

Runbook highlights (we will produce full runbook once MAP signed):
- Pre-test checklist: security allowlist, routing verification, test IP ACLs, and snapshot of prod config.
- Monitoring: token-level latency, error rate, backend GPU utilization, and real-time CSV of QPS.
- Abort conditions: sustained error rate > 1% for 3 minutes or P95 latency > 800ms for 2 consecutive minutes.

Open questions for FintechCo
- Can infra provide a sample of the burstiness (1s granularity) for the 24h window? If not, we’ll resample based on p95/p99 aggregates.
- Any constraint on us creating a temporary routing rule that routes replay traffic to the dedicated pool?

I’ve attached a very short capacity_proposal_qps.pdf to show cost/benefit for the 4x config vs a 2x fallback. Happy to walk through on Wed.

—Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Recap + proposed MAP milestone: load test slot and sizing

Karthik / team —

Couple of operational notes from product/ops side:

1) SLA exception request — because peak burst handling requires headroom we should mark this MAP milestone as "SLA-exception: scheduled" so finance and operations are aware. Vivek, please flag with the deal desk for potential billing surcharge for the dedicated burst window.

2) Runbook approval path — I will own the runbook sign-off after Priyom uploads the draft. Our security/compliance review will need the anonymization checklist from FintechCo (see attached in the MAP spreadsheet).

3) Proposed test window slot: 2027-05-04 02:00 — 04:00 UTC (to avoid your 05-06 deploy). Please confirm if that works; else we can propose 2027-05-05 22:00 — 00:00 UTC.

I’ll queue the HubSpot milestone update once Karthik confirms DocuSign routing.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Operations | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP: Finalize load test slot and dedicated capacity sizing — next steps

Ella / Sergio —

Great — thanks for the quick confirms. Capturing agreed next steps so we have the MAP milestone tidy: 

Agreed items
- Test window: 2027-05-04 02:00 — 04:00 UTC (preferred). FintechCo confirmed avoids your deploy.
- Traffic sample: FintechCo will share anonymized 24h window from 2027-04-28; if possible include 1s granularity for the peak minutes.
- Sizing: Redwood to provision 4x g5-like GPUs for the dedicated test window. Priyom to send final runbook and abort conditions by 2027-04-30.
- DocuSign: I will send MAP_v1 via DocuSign by EOD 2027-04-29 for your procurement review.

Responsible owners
- FintechCo: provide traffic export & ACLs (Ella / Infra team)
- Redwood: runbook & capacity provisioning (Priyom / Marissa)
- Sales / admin: MAP signoff and HubSpot milestone (me / Vivek)

Next meeting
- Quick sync Wed 2027-04-30 09:00 PT (30m) to confirm runbook and ACL checklist. Calendar invite to follow.

Attachments referenced: FintechCo_MAP_v1.xlsx, capacity_proposal_qps.pdf

If any of this needs to change please flag in-thread. Thanks everyone — looking forward to running this cleanly.

—Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
